title: Control
control_text: What to do
references: References

title: Approved AI policy
control_text: Adopt an AI policy approved by senior leadership that states the organisation's principles, risk appetite and approval rules for AI, and review it at least once a year.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Accountability; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.2.2, A.2.4; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 1.2, GOVERN 2.3

title: Named accountable owner
control_text: Assign every AI use case a named business owner who is accountable for its outcomes, and record the technical, data and risk contacts alongside them.
references: UAE AI Charter: Governance and accountability; UAE Gov Services Code: Agentic Reference p.9; Dubai AI Ethics: Accountability; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.3.2; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 2.1

title: AI use-case register
control_text: Keep a single register of all AI systems in use or in development, with owner, purpose, data used, risk tier and status, and keep it current.
references: SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.4.2; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 1.6

title: Impact assessment before approval
control_text: Before approving a use case, assess its likely impact on individuals, groups and the organisation, record the result, and repeat the assessment when the system changes materially.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Accountability; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.5.2, A.5.3, A.5.4; NIST AI RMF: MAP 1.1, MAP 5.1; EU AI Act: Art. 9, Art. 27

title: Go/no-go decision gate
control_text: Require a documented go/no-go decision by an authorised committee or executive before a high-risk system goes live, based on test results and the residual risk.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 2.1, Code 8.8, Agentic Guide §06; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility, Reliability & Safety; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.5; NIST AI RMF: MANAGE 1.1, GOVERN 2.3

title: Third-party AI due diligence
control_text: Before buying or integrating a third-party model or AI service, check its documentation, data handling and known limitations, and set out responsibilities for oversight, incidents and updates in the contract.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Accountability; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.10.2, A.10.3; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 6.1, MANAGE 3.1; EU AI Act: Art. 25

title: AI literacy for staff
control_text: Train staff who build, operate or rely on AI systems in what the systems can and cannot do and in their own responsibilities, proportionate to their role.
references: UAE AI Charter: Promoting AI awareness for an inclusive society; UAE Gov Services Code: Code 6.2; ISO/IEC 42001: A.4.6; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 2.2, MAP 3.4; EU AI Act: Art. 4

title: Agent identity and ownership
control_text: Give each AI agent its own identity (not a shared or personal account) and a named human owner, so that every action it takes can be traced to the agent and to the person accountable for it.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Accountability; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.3.2; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 2.1, GOVERN 3.2

title: Governance review for each agent
control_text: Run a documented governance review of each AI agent before launch, and again whenever its scope, permissions, data or outputs change. Record each decision to continue, modify or stop in a review log kept for that agent.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 2.1, Agentic Guide §06; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.5; NIST AI RMF: MANAGE 1.1

title: Approved scope document for each agent
control_text: Keep an approved, current scope document for each agent that lists the services and cases it may handle, its permissions and access limits, and which decisions it may take alone or must refer to a person. Re-approve it after any material change and block use outside it.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.4, Agentic Guide §05; NIST AI RMF: MAP 3.3

title: Classify systems against the national agentic definition
control_text: Before registering an AI system, classify it as generative, agentic or multi-agent using the national definition and self-assessment criteria. Do not label chatbots, scripted automation, reply-drafting copilots or avatar interfaces as agentic unless they meet every criterion.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Agentic Reference p.6, Agentic Reference p.7, Agentic Reference p.9, Agentic Reference p.13, Agentic Reference p.14; NIST AI RMF: MAP 2.1

title: Disclose AI interaction
control_text: Tell people clearly when they are dealing with an AI system rather than a person, at the start of the interaction.
references: UAE AI Charter: Transparency; UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.6, Agentic Guide §06; Dubai AI Ethics: Transparency; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.8.2; EU AI Act: Art. 50

title: Label AI-generated content
control_text: Mark text, images, audio or video produced by generative AI as AI-generated before it is published or sent to the public.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.8.2; EU AI Act: Art. 50

title: Explanation on request
control_text: Provide a simple way for a person affected by a significant AI-informed decision to ask for, and receive, a plain-language explanation of the main factors behind it.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.6; Dubai AI Ethics: Explainability; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.8.2; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.9; EU AI Act: Art. 86

title: Notify people of AI-informed decisions
control_text: Inform people when a decision that significantly affects them is made or supported by an AI system, including employees affected by AI used at work.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.6; Dubai AI Ethics: Transparency; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.8.5; EU AI Act: Art. 26

title: System documentation
control_text: Maintain documentation for each system covering its purpose, design, data, model version, test results and known limitations, detailed enough for a reviewer to understand it.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Transparency; SDAIA AI Ethics: Reliability & Safety, Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.3, A.6.2.7; NIST AI RMF: MAP 2.1, MAP 2.2; EU AI Act: Art. 11

title: Public statement of AI use
control_text: Publish a plain-language summary of where the organisation uses AI in services to the public, what data it relies on and how to raise a concern.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Transparency; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.8.5; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 4.2

title: Instructions for operators
control_text: Give the people who operate or rely on a system written instructions on its intended use, accuracy, limits and when not to trust its output.
references: SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.8.2; NIST AI RMF: MAP 2.2; EU AI Act: Art. 13

title: Show the data sources an agent used
control_text: When an agent delivers a service, tell the customer which data sources it relied on and, before it acts, which of their data it will use.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.2, Agentic Guide §03; Dubai AI Ethics: Transparency; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.8.2

title: Clear notice when the AI cannot finish
control_text: If the AI cannot complete a service, tell the customer promptly and in plain language what went wrong and what the next steps are, including how to reach a person.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 4.5, Agentic Guide §03

title: Data sources and provenance
control_text: Record where each dataset used to build, tune or run the system comes from, the right to use it, and how it was collected and prepared.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Privacy; SDAIA AI Ethics: Privacy & Security; ISO/IEC 42001: A.7.2, A.7.3, A.7.5; NIST AI RMF: MAP 2.3; EU AI Act: Art. 10

title: Data quality and representativeness
control_text: Check that training and input data are accurate, complete and representative of the people the system will affect, and document the checks and any gaps.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.3; Dubai AI Ethics: Fairness; SDAIA AI Ethics: Fairness, Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.7.4, A.7.6; NIST AI RMF: MAP 2.3; EU AI Act: Art. 10

title: Privacy review and data minimisation
control_text: Where personal data is involved, complete a privacy review and use only the minimum personal data the purpose needs, in line with the organisation's data protection policy.
references: UAE AI Charter: Data privacy; UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.2, Code 5.7, Data Sharing Policy Art. 5; Dubai AI Ethics: Privacy; SDAIA AI Ethics: Privacy & Security; ISO/IEC 42001: A.2.3, A.7.3; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.10

title: Sensitive attributes justified
control_text: Do not use sensitive attributes (or close proxies for them) as model inputs unless there is a documented, approved justification such as bias testing.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Fairness; SDAIA AI Ethics: Fairness; ISO/IEC 42001: A.7.4; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.11; EU AI Act: Art. 10

title: Bias and fairness testing
control_text: Test outcomes across relevant groups before launch and after major changes, set an acceptable threshold in advance, and record the results and any mitigations.
references: UAE AI Charter: Algorithmic bias; Dubai AI Ethics: Fairness; SDAIA AI Ethics: Fairness; ISO/IEC 42001: A.5.4, A.6.2.4; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.11; EU AI Act: Art. 10

title: Rules for data in generative AI tools
control_text: Set clear rules on what information staff may enter into generative AI tools, and block personal, sensitive or classified data from external services unless explicitly approved.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Privacy; SDAIA AI Ethics: Privacy & Security; ISO/IEC 42001: A.2.3, A.9.2; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 6.1, MEASURE 2.10

title: Rights to training and grounding content
control_text: Confirm the organisation has the right to use the documents and content used to train, fine-tune or ground a model, and keep a record of that check.
references: SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.7.3, A.7.5; NIST AI RMF: MAP 4.1, GOVERN 6.1; EU AI Act: Art. 53

title: Authoritative sources, no shadow copies
control_text: Have AI systems fetch government data from the authoritative (golden) source when it is needed and use it only for the authorised purpose. Do not keep copies for reuse or build parallel data stores.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.3, Code 5.7, Data Sharing Policy Art. 5, Data Sharing Policy Art. 8

title: Ask once
control_text: Design AI-led services so they never ask the customer for data or documents the government already holds and may use. Retrieve them from the source instead, and ask only for what is genuinely missing, saying why it is needed.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 1.5, Code 5.4, Agentic Guide §03, Agentic Guide §06, Data Sharing Policy Art. 5, Data Sharing Policy Art. 8

title: Defined human oversight model
control_text: Decide and document, for each use case, where humans review, approve or monitor the system's outputs, and assign that role to people with the competence and authority to act.
references: UAE AI Charter: Human oversight; UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.4, Agentic Guide §05, Agentic Reference p.7; Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.1.3; NIST AI RMF: MAP 3.5, GOVERN 3.2; EU AI Act: Art. 14, Art. 26

title: Right to challenge a decision
control_text: Give people a clear route to challenge a significant AI-informed decision and have it reviewed by a human who can change it.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 2.4, Agentic Guide §03, Agentic Guide §06; Dubai AI Ethics: Accountability; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.8.3; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 3.3

title: Guard against over-reliance
control_text: Train reviewers to question AI outputs rather than rubber-stamp them, and check periodically how often they override the system.
references: ISO/IEC 42001: A.4.6; NIST AI RMF: MAP 3.4, GOVERN 3.2; EU AI Act: Art. 14

title: Autonomy limits for agents
control_text: Document what an agent may do on its own, what it must never do, and the limits it works within (for example amounts, record types or number of actions), and enforce these limits technically.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.4, Agentic Guide §05, Agentic Reference p.8; Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.9.4; NIST AI RMF: MAP 3.3, GOVERN 3.2; EU AI Act: Art. 14

title: Human approval for irreversible actions
control_text: Require a named human to approve any agent action that cannot easily be undone or that significantly affects a person, such as payments, deletions, external messages or decisions on entitlements.
references: UAE AI Charter: Human oversight; UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.2, Agentic Guide §03; Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Reliability & Safety; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.1.3; NIST AI RMF: MAP 3.5, GOVERN 3.2; EU AI Act: Art. 14

title: Stop switch and rollback
control_text: Provide a tested way for authorised staff to pause or shut down an agent immediately and to reverse or correct the actions it has already taken.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.5; Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.6; NIST AI RMF: MANAGE 2.4; EU AI Act: Art. 14

title: Specific approval for each agent action
control_text: Before an agent acts for a customer, show a short plan and ask for approval of that specific action, the data it will use and any cost. Never rely on open-ended or blanket permission, and record each approval or refusal.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.2, Agentic Guide §03, Agentic Guide §06

title: One-step revocation of agent permissions
control_text: Let customers stop an agent, or withdraw the permissions and consents they gave it, in a single step. Apply the withdrawal immediately and confirm it to them.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.2, Agentic Guide §02, Agentic Guide §06

title: Handover to a person with full context
control_text: Hand the case to a person when the customer asks, or when it is complex, sensitive, beyond what the AI is permitted to do, or failing. Pass on the request, context, actions taken and approvals so the customer never has to repeat their story.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 1.7, Code 8.2, Agentic Guide §03, Agentic Guide §06

title: Explicit consent before any payment
control_text: Before an agent makes a payment, show the fees, items, total, receiving entity and payment method, take the customer's explicit consent, and pay only through approved government payment channels. Follow up on any charge where the service was not completed.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 1.6, Code 5.8, Agentic Guide §03, Agentic Guide §06

title: Test before deployment
control_text: Test the system against defined accuracy and safety criteria, including unusual and edge-case inputs, in conditions close to real use before it goes live.
references: UAE AI Charter: Safety; UAE Gov Services Code: Code 8.8, Agentic Guide §06; Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Reliability & Safety; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.4; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.5, MEASURE 2.6; EU AI Act: Art. 15

title: AI-specific security assessment
control_text: Assess AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning and data leakage through outputs, and include the resulting requirements in the system specification.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Privacy & Security; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.2; NIST AI RMF: MAP 1.6, MEASURE 2.7; EU AI Act: Art. 15

title: Safeguards on generated output
control_text: Put checks on generative output (grounding in approved sources, filters for harmful or false content, and human review where it matters) before it reaches customers or decisions.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Reliability & Safety; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.4; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.6

title: Least-privilege tools and permissions
control_text: Give an agent access only to the tools, systems and data it needs for its task, with read-only access by default and write access granted case by case.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.1, Code 5.7; Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Privacy & Security; ISO/IEC 42001: A.4.4, A.6.2.2; NIST AI RMF: MAP 4.2; EU AI Act: Art. 15

title: Sandbox and staged rollout for agents
control_text: Run a new agent in a test or shadow mode, where its proposed actions are recorded but not executed, before giving it live access, and widen its scope in stages.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Reliability & Safety; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.4, A.6.2.5; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.3, MEASURE 2.6

title: Fallback and fail-safe
control_text: Define what happens when the system fails or is switched off, including a manual or non-AI fallback, so the service can continue safely.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 8.2; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; NIST AI RMF: MANAGE 2.1, MEASURE 2.6; EU AI Act: Art. 15

title: Screen for prohibited uses
control_text: Screen every proposed use case against prohibited practices, such as social scoring or manipulating behaviour, and stop any that fall within them.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Reliability & Safety; ISO/IEC 42001: A.9.4; NIST AI RMF: MANAGE 1.1; EU AI Act: Art. 5

title: Identity and authority check before each automated action
control_text: Before an agent or other automated process carries out an action, verify the identity of the person it acts for and confirm the action is within approved permissions. Block the action otherwise.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.1; Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Privacy & Security

title: Red-team and jailbreak testing
control_text: Before launch and after major changes, have people who did not build the system try to make it misbehave: jailbreaks, direct and indirect prompt injection (including through documents, emails or web pages it reads), extraction of confidential data, and misuse of its tools. Record what is found, fix it and test again.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Privacy & Security; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.4; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 1.3, MEASURE 2.6, MEASURE 2.7; EU AI Act: Art. 15, Art. 55

title: Model supply chain security
control_text: Keep a list of the models, datasets and AI libraries the system depends on, with their source, version and licence. Take them only from trusted sources, check their integrity before use, pin versions, and track vulnerabilities and upstream changes, so that a tampered or silently updated component cannot reach production.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Privacy & Security; ISO/IEC 42001: A.4.4, A.10.3; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 6.1, MAP 4.1, MANAGE 3.2; EU AI Act: Art. 15, Art. 25

title: Performance monitoring with alerts
control_text: Monitor the system in production against agreed measures, set alert thresholds in advance, and assign each alert to someone who must respond.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 2.1; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility, Reliability & Safety; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.6; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.4, MANAGE 4.1; EU AI Act: Art. 26, Art. 72

title: Event logging
control_text: Log inputs, outputs, model version and key events automatically, and keep the logs long enough to investigate complaints and incidents.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.6; Dubai AI Ethics: Transparency; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.8; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.4; EU AI Act: Art. 12, Art. 26

title: Agent action audit trail
control_text: Record every tool call and action an agent takes, with its inputs, the reason given, the result and any human approval, in a log the agent itself cannot alter.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.6, Agentic Guide §06, Agentic Reference p.9; Dubai AI Ethics: Transparency; SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.8; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.4; EU AI Act: Art. 12

title: AI incident response
control_text: Define how AI incidents and serious errors are reported, investigated, fixed and communicated to affected people and, where required, to regulators.
references: SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.8.4; NIST AI RMF: MANAGE 4.3, MANAGE 2.3; EU AI Act: Art. 73

title: Periodic review and re-tiering
control_text: Review each system on a set schedule and after significant changes, check for drift and new risks, and update its risk tier and controls.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 2.1; SDAIA AI Ethics: Reliability & Safety; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.6; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 1.5, MEASURE 3.1; EU AI Act: Art. 9

title: Channel to report concerns
control_text: Provide staff and users with a channel to report problems or concerns about an AI system, and track each report to closure.
references: SDAIA AI Ethics: Transparency & Explainability; ISO/IEC 42001: A.3.3, A.8.3; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 5.1, MEASURE 3.3

title: Safe decommissioning
control_text: Plan how a system will be retired, including data deletion or archiving, access removal and informing users, and follow the plan when it is withdrawn.
references: Dubai AI Ethics: Security; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.6; NIST AI RMF: GOVERN 1.7, MANAGE 2.4

title: Agent behaviour limits and auto-pause
control_text: Watch agents for unusual behaviour such as loops, spikes in actions or cost, or attempts to use tools outside their scope, and pause them automatically when limits are hit.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 5.5, Agentic Reference p.8; Dubai AI Ethics: Security; SDAIA AI Ethics: Accountability & Responsibility; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.6; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.4, MANAGE 2.4

title: KPIs and a continue/stop decision for each agent
control_text: Set KPIs for each agent covering decision quality, bias and impact on the service against a pre-launch baseline. Review them on a fixed schedule alongside customer feedback, and record a decision to continue, modify or stop.
references: UAE Gov Services Code: Code 2.1, Code 2.3, Agentic Guide §05, Agentic Guide §06; SDAIA AI Ethics: Reliability & Safety; ISO/IEC 42001: A.6.2.6; NIST AI RMF: MEASURE 2.4, MANAGE 1.1
